headline: A small gain. One regression we need to fix.
summary: Fast analysis finds 10 of 14 published landmarks, up from 9. Balanced and Thorough also find more, but all three lose the Evergreen Game’s 20.Rxe7+. The evidence supports more testing, not a clean replacement sign-off.
releaseNote: We’re aiming for Mobile Maia 2.7. Open Brilly Finder remains a draft; the Evergreen regression and broader quality checks need review before promotion.
card: We tested nine famous games against fourteen published Brilliant landmarks. The new model finds a little more—and loses a move we should not ignore. Explore the actual boards, gains and misses.

notes.title: Opera: a new award, not a new landmark hit.
notes.text: Both classifiers find 16.Qb8+!!. The new one also awards 13.Rxd7, which our chosen annotation marks !. That is a generous promotion, not an extra match to its published !!.

notes.title: Fischer: the total stays three in Fast.
notes.text: The new list keeps 11...Na4 and 17...Be6, adds 15...Nxc3 and drops 19...Ne2+. Balanced also recovers Na4. These changes make the emphasis different; they do not turn three awards into five.

notes.title: Two famous queens are recovered.
notes.text: The Immortal Game’s 22.Qf6+ and Marshall’s 23...Qg3 gain Brilliant in every mode. Both are explicit !! landmarks in the frozen sources.

notes.title: Evergreen is the counterexample.
notes.text: The old classifier finds 20.Rxe7+!!; the new one gives Interesting in every mode. Its model score is about 0.021, far below the fixed 0.8193 cutoff. This is a model rejection, not an unfinished confirmation search.

notes.title: Kasparov needs the deeper run.
notes.text: The new model finds 24.Rxd4 only in Thorough. Fast and Balanced still call it Interesting. The headline uses Fast, as planned, rather than selecting the most flattering mode.

notes.title: A quiet king walk still escapes.
notes.text: Neither classifier finds Short’s 31.Kh2!! in any mode. Both award the later 34.Kg5, marked ! by the chosen grandmaster. Finding sacrificial ideas does not cover every human use of Brilliant.

notes.title: Extra awards still need judgment.
notes.text: Fast produces 19 total Brilliant awards before and 20 after. Ten in each list lie outside the fourteen frozen landmarks. Some are source ! moves; others are not listed in that source scope. Those counts cannot establish a false-positive rate.

notes.title: The shared engine evidence has a warning sign.
notes.text: Both classifiers call Opera15.Bxd7+ a Blunder in Fast and a Mistake in Balanced, while Thorough leaves it unmarked. Balanced recommends that move before playing it, then lowers its evaluation afterward. This shared search instability is separate from Open Brilly Finder; the study does not validate every non-Brilliant grade.
